cases.name: issue2177_crescent_on_top_of_rim_checked
cases.note: #2177: a cylinder r 10, z 0..10, united with a crescent prism on its top rim, z 10..15 (the r 6 cylinder centred at (10, 0) less the r 10 cylinder, both 5 tall, moved up 10), touching it only along the r 10 arc through the cylinder's seam vertex at (10, 0, 10). crates/solidcore/tests/issue_2177_crescent_on_top_of_rim.rs sweeps the crescent from its two arcs instead. At the default fixes (upstream behaviour, CloseIntersectionLoop relates the rim's long arc with the crescent's r 6 arc, WR-528) compares the failed tests of SMLib's capi check (level 2) of the union with the port's.
